retrieved_sources.title: Autism Spectrum Social Stories in Schools Trial 2 (ASSSIST‐2): a pragmatic randomised controlled trial of the Social Stories™ intervention to address the social and emotional health of autistic children in UK primary schools

gioi_han: Primary intention-to-treat social responsiveness outcome was not statistically significant; individual socio-emotional goals improved.
Do not claim global social-skill, anxiety, depression or caregiver-stress improvement from individual-goal findings.
Social Stories are not PEERS and this trial does not reproduce a licensed PEERS treatment manual.
No independent clinical review; research/internal noncommercial use, no individual diagnosis or prescription.
